success.description: 44 A location or area within medium range of you is buried under an avalanche of snow and ice.
As above, and all creatures in that area suffer 2 fatigue, 2 stress, and 2 wounds.

boon.description: You may exclude up to 2 creatures in the area from being affected by the avalanche.

bane.description: The avalanche is out of control! It spreads far beyond the desired area {Dm}.

conservative.requirements: 6 power. Must be either outdoors or within long range of a quantity of snow or ice. Buried creatures must spend Average ); manoeuvres and pass three total (2d) Athletics (St) checks to dig themselves out.
